label: Plate design
tip: Two plates: choose arms above/below the bottom and one optional clamp on the opposite side of the arms. The upper clamp carries the FC stack; below-bottom arms keep the FC stack on the bottom. Three plates: arms between bottom and mid, with an optional captured keystone.
help: Two plates: choose arms above/below the bottom and one optional clamp on the opposite side of the arms. The upper clamp carries the FC stack; below-bottom arms keep the FC stack on the bottom. Three plates: arms between bottom and mid, with an optional captured keystone.

label: FPV camera drone
tip: Add camera side plates captured by tabs in the bottom and top, plus rear VTX holes. The nose and rear decks extend to support them.
help: Add camera side plates captured by tabs in the bottom and top, plus rear VTX holes. The nose and rear decks extend to support them.

label: Motor layout
help: Select True X for a symmetric motor layout, Stretched X for a wider left/right span, or Deadcat for wider front motor spacing.

label: Diagonal wheelbase
tip: Distance between diagonally opposite motor centres, not the carbon frame's outside size.
help: Sets the base diagonal between opposite motor centres. It is not the carbon outline. With zero rear extension this is the actual diagonal; a Deadcat rear extension increases the actual diagonal shown in the editor summary.

label: Length / rear width
tip: Stretched X: left–right motor span divided by front–rear spacing. Deadcat: length divided by rear span. Ignored for True X.
help: Stretched X: left–right motor span divided by front–rear spacing. Deadcat: length divided by rear span. Ignored for True X.

label: Front / rear motor span
tip: Deadcat only: +Y front motor span / rear span. Rear reach and arm length grow as the front spreads; both motor diagonals remain the entered wheelbase.
help: Deadcat only: front motor span / rear span in the base layout. Automatic rear reach compensates for front spread while preserving the base diagonals. Independent rear arm extension is applied afterwards and changes the final rear span and diagonal.

label: Deadcat rear arm extension
help: Deadcat only. Extra length, in mm, added to each rear arm along its existing root-to-motor direction. Zero keeps the original layout. Front motor positions and all arm roots stay fixed. Rear span and actual diagonals grow; the base wheelbase is unchanged. The value is retained but ignored in True X and Stretched X.

label: Propeller diameter
tip: Full propeller diameter: 5 inch = 127 mm; 5.1 inch = 129.54 mm; 7 inch = 177.8 mm.
help: Full propeller diameter: 5 inch = 127 mm; 5.1 inch = 129.54 mm; 7 inch = 177.8 mm.

label: Desired prop gap
help: Desired minimum clearance between neighbouring propeller discs. A smaller calculated gap produces a layout warning; changing this value does not move the motors.

label: CornerRadius
help: Radius at the main plate corners. Widened-centre transitions use straight tapered shoulders.

label: Bottom plate reach
tip: Automatic computes the outer limits. Bottom body reach behind stack independently controls the three-plate body edge. Rear clamping tabs follow the actual rear arm-root outlines. Custom front/rear reaches cap the outline without automatic growth; two-plate bottoms keep their full profile.
help: Automatic computes the outer limits. Bottom body reach behind stack independently controls the three-plate body edge. Rear clamping tabs follow the actual rear arm-root outlines. Custom front/rear reaches cap the outline without automatic growth; two-plate bottoms keep their full profile.

label: Bottom base length
tip: Automatic base length before the front extension. Three-plate bottoms are trimmed behind the rear arm sandwich; use Custom for exact independent reaches.
help: Automatic base length before the front extension. Three-plate bottoms are trimmed behind the rear arm sandwich; use Custom for exact independent reaches.

label: Bottom front extension (3 plates)
tip: Extra bottom length toward +Y in three-plate mode. Its rear edge does not move. Ignored in two-plate mode.
help: Extra bottom length toward +Y in three-plate mode. Its rear edge does not move. Ignored in two-plate mode.

label: Bottom reach toward front (+Y)
help: In Custom bottom reach mode, distance from frame Y=0 to the front body edge. It is independent of the stack-referenced rear body dimension.

label: Bottom outer rear limit (frame Y=0)
tip: Maximum rearward extent of the bottom plate in Custom mode. In three-plate designs the rear tabs follow the arms, including fitted joints and keystone pockets; extending this limit does not add a full-width rear deck.
help: Maximum rearward extent of the bottom plate in Custom mode. In three-plate designs the rear tabs follow the arms, including fitted joints and keystone pockets; extending this limit does not add a full-width rear deck.

label: Bottom body reach behind stack
tip: Three-plate main-body distance behind the FC stack centre. Rear edge Y = Stack Offset Y minus this reach. Increase it to fill more of the centre between the rear arm tabs; decrease it to shorten the body. Tabs still follow the arms beyond that edge. Mounting support is checked.
help: Three-plate main-body distance behind the FC stack centre. Rear edge Y = Stack Offset Y minus this reach. Increase it to fill more of the centre between the rear arm tabs; decrease it to shorten the body. Tabs still follow the arms beyond that edge. Mounting support is checked.

label: Bottom / mid base width
help: Normal width of the bottom and mid bodies. Centre-width controls can widen their stack and arm-clamping regions independently.

label: BottomThickness
help: Stock thickness of the bottom plate; changes the arm sandwich, camera lower seats and actual standoff support levels.

label: Bottom plate outline
tip: Base outline before centre widening, arm-matched tabs and applied cutouts. Reaches and width retain their existing meaning. Check fastener support after narrowing an end.
help: Base outline before centre widening, arm-matched tabs and applied cutouts. Reaches and width retain their existing meaning. Check fastener support after narrowing an end.

label: Plate end width
tip: Narrow-end width as a percentage of the base width for tapered, hexagonal and shield outlines. Does not alter the independently widened centre. 100 percent removes the taper.
help: Narrow-end width as a percentage of the base width for tapered, hexagonal and shield outlines. Does not alter the independently widened centre. 100 percent removes the taper.

tip: Target plan-view corner radius in mm; zero keeps the finished plate unchanged. Rounds outer edges and outline notches after cutting. Closed cutout corners are included only when Round internal openings is enabled for this plate. Tight corners use smaller local radii to preserve edge lengths, mounting support and minimum web; constrained corners are reported. Circular drills, tangent slots, plate thickness and countersinks retain their geometry.

help: Trim only the absolute front of the bottom plate. Straight retains the existing outline. The nose never extends beyond the front reach. Arm and standoff positions stay fixed.

label: Front edge depth
tip: Fore/aft shaping depth in mm. Convex noses retreat at the shoulders; concave noses retreat at the centre. Keep enough stock around front standoffs and camera sockets.
help: Fore/aft shaping depth in mm. Convex noses retreat at the shoulders; concave noses retreat at the centre. Keep enough stock around front standoffs and camera sockets.

label: Front tip width
tip: Width of the flat front tip as a percentage of the nose span. Used by flat-tip, swept, stepped and recessed profiles; other profiles ignore it.
help: Width of the flat front tip as a percentage of the nose span. Used by flat-tip, swept, stepped and recessed profiles; other profiles ignore it.

label: Rear edge shape
tip: Trim the rear inside its existing reach. Mounting locations and required material remain checked. Bottom rear shaping is available only in two-plate mode; mid rear shaping only in three-plate mode.
help: Trim the rear inside its existing reach. Mounting locations and required material remain checked. Bottom rear shaping is available only in two-plate mode; mid rear shaping only in three-plate mode.

label: Rear edge depth
tip: Fore/aft depth of the rear shaping zone in mm; never adds stock beyond the rear reach.
help: Fore/aft depth of the rear shaping zone in mm; never adds stock beyond the rear reach.

label: Rear feature width
tip: Feature half-width as a percentage of the rear half-span. Controls flats, stepped tips and central cable/recess openings where applicable.
help: Feature half-width as a percentage of the rear half-span. Controls flats, stepped tips and central cable/recess openings where applicable.

label: Mid plate reach
tip: Automatic can extend the mid rear deck to support the VTX. Custom uses the exact front/rear reaches measured from the stack centre.
help: Automatic can extend the mid rear deck to support the VTX. Custom uses the exact front/rear reaches measured from the stack centre.

label: Mid body reach ahead of stack
tip: Front reach of the main stack deck. Its front arm-clamping tabs follow the actual arm-root outlines, including width, fitted joints and key pockets, within the bottom support.
help: Front reach of the main stack deck. Its front arm-clamping tabs follow the actual arm-root outlines, including width, fitted joints and key pockets, within the bottom support.

label: Mid body reach behind stack
tip: Main mid plate extends this far rearward from the stack centre. Independent of bottom plate length.
help: Main mid plate extends this far rearward from the stack centre. Independent of bottom plate length.

label: Mid plate thickness
help: Stock thickness of the mid plate in three-plate mode. The mid carries the FC stack and rear electronics.

label: Mid plate outline
tip: Independent mid-plate base outline. The fitted front-arm tabs still follow the actual arms; changing the base does not move mounting holes.
help: Independent mid-plate base outline. The fitted front-arm tabs still follow the actual arms; changing the base does not move mounting holes.

tip: Trim the rear inside its existing reach. Mounting locations and required material remain checked. Bottom rear shaping is available only in two-plate mode; mid rear shaping only in three-plate mode.
help: Trim the rear inside its existing reach. Mounting locations and required material remain checked. Bottom rear shaping is available only in two-plate mode; mid rear shaping only in three-plate mode.

label: Rear edge depth
tip: Fore/aft depth of the rear shaping zone in mm; never adds stock beyond the rear reach.

tip: Feature half-width as a percentage of the rear half-span. Controls flats, stepped tips and central cable/recess openings where applicable.
help: Feature half-width as a percentage of the rear half-span. Controls flats, stepped tips and central cable/recess openings where applicable.

tip: Automatic covers the camera and rear VTX. Custom uses the exact independent reaches from frame centre; insufficient coverage is reported.
help: Automatic covers the camera and rear VTX. Custom uses the exact independent reaches from frame centre; insufficient coverage is reported.

label: Top plate length
help: Initial centred top-plate length in Automatic mode. Required camera, VTX and mounting support may extend its ends. Custom mode uses the separate front and rear reaches.

label: Top reach toward front (+Y)
help: In Custom top reach mode, distance from frame Y=0 to the front edge. Shortening it changes the sloping camera-wall attachment when plate following is enabled.

help: In Custom top reach mode, distance from frame Y=0 toward the rear edge. Keep the top long enough to cover the VTX and support the rear standoffs.

label: Top base width
help: Normal top-plate body width. Top centre width adds a wider middle section when enabled.

label: TopThickness
help: Stock thickness of the top plate. Camera upper tongues and their receiving sockets follow this thickness.

label: Top plate outline
tip: Top outline before strap slots, camera sockets, front edge profiles and custom cuts. Tapered ends may require more width for standoffs and camera tabs.
help: Top outline before strap slots, camera sockets, front edge profiles and custom cuts. Tapered ends may require more width for standoffs and camera tabs.

label: Front edge shape
tip: Top front outline inside the existing front reach. Camera recesses clear the centre and can set back the shoulders; Straight preserves the existing profile. This profile is the sole built-in top-front camera opening.

label: Front edge depth
tip: Fore/aft shaping depth. For camera recesses, measured behind the set-back shoulder line to the deepest point. Mounting holes and camera tabs retain support checks.
help: Fore/aft shaping depth. For camera recesses, measured behind the set-back shoulder line to the deepest point. Mounting holes and camera tabs retain support checks.

label: Front feature width
tip: Central feature width as a percentage of the front span for flat-tip, swept, stepped and general recessed profiles. Camera-specific recesses use Camera recess width instead.
help: Central feature width as a percentage of the front span for flat-tip, swept, stepped and general recessed profiles. Camera-specific recesses use Camera recess width instead.

label: Camera recess width (0 = auto)
tip: Camera-specific opening width in mm. Zero uses camera width plus twice the top front camera clearance. Flared and swept mouths open up to 20 percent wider; stepped/flared bottoms are narrower. This sets a profile, not a measured guarantee of camera clearance.
help: Camera-specific opening width in mm. Zero uses camera width plus twice the top front camera clearance. Flared and swept mouths open up to 20 percent wider; stepped/flared bottoms are narrower. This sets a profile, not a measured guarantee of camera clearance.

label: Camera recess clearance
tip: Extra clearance on each side of the camera body when Camera recess width is automatic. Used only by top-front camera recesses; custom width is used directly.
help: Extra clearance on each side of the camera body when Camera recess width is automatic. Used only by top-front camera recesses; custom width is used directly.

label: Camera shoulder setback
tip: Retract both front shoulders from the current top front reach, in mm. Applied only to camera-specific profiles. Depth is measured from this new shoulder line; the full recess reaches setback plus depth behind the original front.
help: Retract both front shoulders from the current top front reach, in mm. Applied only to camera-specific profiles. Depth is measured from this new shoulder line; the full recess reaches setback plus depth behind the original front.

help: Feature half-width as a percentage of the rear half-span. Controls flats, stepped tips and central cable/recess openings where applicable.

label: Bottom centre width (0 = off)
tip: Zero keeps the base width. A larger value widens only the middle stack/arm section, with tapered shoulders. Front/rear reach stays exact.
help: Zero keeps the base width. A larger value widens only the middle stack/arm section, with tapered shoulders. Front/rear reach stays exact.

label: Mid centre width (0 = off)
tip: Independent centre widening for the mid body. The integrated front arm tabs still follow the actual roots.
help: Independent centre widening for the mid body. The integrated front arm tabs still follow the actual roots.

label: Top centre width (0 = off)
tip: Independent centre widening for the top. Camera and rear sections retain their normal width outside the taper.
help: Independent centre widening for the top. Camera and rear sections retain their normal width outside the taper.

label: Clamp centre width (0 = off)
tip: Independent centre widening for the active upper or lower arm clamp in two-plate designs.
help: Independent centre widening for the active upper or lower arm clamp in two-plate designs.

label: Full-width centre length
tip: Length of the full-width region shared by the plate centre profiles. Each plate is clipped to its own front/rear reach.
help: Length of the full-width region shared by the plate centre profiles. Each plate is clipped to its own front/rear reach.

label: Taper length at each end
tip: Length of each sloping transition from the normal plate width to its widened centre.
help: Length of each sloping transition from the normal plate width to its widened centre.

label: Centre section position Y
tip: Position of the widened section, measured from frame centre. Positive is front.
help: Position of the widened section, measured from frame centre. Positive is front.

label: Arm roots follow wider bottom centre
tip: When enabled, the arm root inset is measured from the local widened bottom edge. Disable to retain the original arm-root spacing. Deadcat compensation follows the actual roots.
help: When enabled, the arm root inset is measured from the local widened bottom edge. Disable to retain the original arm-root spacing. Deadcat compensation follows the actual roots.

label: ArmThickness
help: Carbon stock thickness of each arm and the matching keystone. Changes the stack of material clamped by the root bolts.

label: ArmWidth
help: Width of the ordinary arm beam. Use Arm root width to enlarge only its inner mounting region.

label: Arm beam profile
tip: Changes the beam outline around its straight centreline. Root references, bolt positions and motor centres remain fixed. The shaping begins beyond the arm bolts and widened root shoulder.
help: Changes the beam outline around its straight centreline. Root references, bolt positions and motor centres remain fixed. The shaping begins beyond the arm bolts and widened root shoulder.

label: Arm profile widening
tip: Maximum extra beam width as a percentage of Arm width. Arm width remains the minimum beam stock width. Zero removes extra widening. Choose Straight for an unshaped solid beam. Root fitting and plate-following tabs use the finished profile.
help: Maximum extra beam width as a percentage of Arm width. Arm width remains the minimum beam stock width. Zero removes extra widening. Choose Straight for an unshaped solid beam. Root fitting and plate-following tabs use the finished profile.

label: Arm corner fillet
tip: Adaptive beam/motor-pad corner radius from the root outward. The root outline and mounting stock remain unchanged; radii reduce locally to preserve material.
help: Adaptive beam/motor-pad corner radius from the root outward. The root outline and mounting stock remain unchanged; radii reduce locally to preserve material.

label: Fillet arm internal openings
tip: Also round corners in arm cutouts. Disabled by default; circular fixing holes remain circular.
help: Also round corners in arm cutouts. Disabled by default; circular fixing holes remain circular.

help: The front/rear arm root reference centres sit at +Y and -Y of this distance. Moving custom bolts does not move these references or the motors.

label: Arm root fit
tip: Independent keeps the rounded tails. Fitted miters trim the roots along shared joint lines, allowing them to meet without overlapping. Root centres, mounting holes and motor positions stay where you set them.
help: Independent keeps the rounded tails. Fitted miters trim the roots along shared joint lines, allowing them to meet without overlapping. Root centres, mounting holes and motor positions stay where you set them.

label: Arm joint clearance
tip: Complete gap between neighbouring fitted arms. Zero gives nominal contact where the tails reach each other; use a small positive gap for your cutting process. Increase the tail extension if the roots do not yet meet.
help: Complete gap between neighbouring fitted arms. Zero gives nominal contact where the tails reach each other; use a small positive gap for your cutting process. Increase the tail extension if the roots do not yet meet.

label: Arm bolt placement
tip: Along arm uses the centred pair and Arm root bolt spacing. Custom coordinates uses independent frame-aligned X/Y offsets from each root reference centre. The front-right reference pattern is mirrored across the frame.
help: Along arm uses the centred pair and Arm root bolt spacing. Custom coordinates uses independent frame-aligned X/Y offsets from each root reference centre. The front-right reference pattern is mirrored across the frame.

help: Round hole keeps the existing circular stack-access relief in each arm. label: Keystone clearance per mating edge
tip: Lateral gap between the key and each arm seat. Zero gives nominal contact; allow a suitable fit for your cutting process.
help: Lateral gap between the key and each arm seat. Zero gives nominal contact; allow a suitable fit for your cutting process.

label: Motor pad outline
tip: Choose from twenty-one motor-pad outlines. The catalogue shows every outline with the same coloured motor-end view, a description and its applicable controls. All fixing-hole spacing stays as entered and rotates with the arm.
help: Choose a motor bearing outline. The first ten choices through Scalloped shield are retained. Twelve shield variations add shallow edge scallops, varied shoulders and compact crowns.

label: Motor pad overall width
help: Nominal motor-pad size. Some shoulders, tails or lobes extend beyond this dimension. Enlarge it when the selected hole pattern lacks edge material.

label: Motor corner / chamfer / scallop size
tip: Corner radius for Rounded square; chamfer for Chamfered square, Shouldered and Tapered nose/Arrowhead. Scalloped shield also uses this size for its three edge reliefs. Inactive for Round, Four-lobe, Teardrop and Compact hex.
help: Corner radius or chamfer on the listed original shapes; edge scallop size on Scalloped shield. On the twelve shield variations it controls shallow scallop depth. Material checks still apply.

label: Motor pad rotation pivot
tip: Choose the fixed point used by mirrored whole-pad rotation.
help: Motor centre keeps each motor and prop centre fixed. Pad beginning pivots at the root-facing extent of the unrotated pad outline, where it meets the beam. The motor, fixing holes, tip features and references move together. A full arm-width elbow joins the beam to the moved pad. Existing designs retain Motor centre.

label: Motor pad rotation (mirrored)
tip: Rotate complete pads around the selected pivot with mirrored signs at reflected corners.
help: Signed rotation about Motor pad rotation pivot. Front-right/rear-left use this angle; front-left/rear-right use the opposite angle. Root bolts and main beam directions remain fixed. Motor centre mode retains motor positions; Pad beginning mode moves motor and prop centres and updates clearance checks. Motor hole rotation remains an independent local offset.

label: Rotated pad transition radius
tip: Rounds inward junctions near a rotated motor pad using a 2D rolling-radius blend. Adds local supporting material without rounding the carbon thickness edges. Zero keeps the original junction. Reduce if a large radius cannot be built.
help: Rounds inward junctions near a rotated motor pad using a 2D rolling-radius blend. Adds local supporting material without rounding the carbon thickness edges. Zero keeps the original junction. Reduce if a large radius cannot be built.

label: Motor tip extension
tip: For Tapered nose or Arrowhead, extra reach beyond half the motor pad width, away from the frame. It changes the arm end, while the motor centre and screw pattern stay in place.
help: Extra outward tip reach for Tapered nose and Arrowhead. Replacement platforms use Motor pad neck length for their root-facing necks instead.

label: Enable motor tip slot
tip: Cut a separate rounded relief slot near the end of a Tapered nose or Arrowhead. It does not replace motor screw holes; airflow settings are independent.
help: Cut a separate rounded relief slot near the end of a Tapered nose or Arrowhead. It does not replace motor screw holes; airflow settings are independent.

label: Motor tip slot width
tip: Width of the optional tip relief. Keep the configured material around the outside edge, motor screws and centre bore.
help: Width of the optional tip relief. Keep the configured material around the outside edge, motor screws and centre bore.

label: Motor tip slot total length
tip: Complete end-to-end length, including the semicircular ends. The slot sits one quarter of the extension beyond the normal pad front; increase the extension if the cut leaves too little material.
help: Complete end-to-end length, including the semicircular ends. The slot sits one quarter of the extension beyond the normal pad front; increase the extension if the cut leaves too little material.

label: Motor pad neck length
tip: Length of the root-facing neck on the twelve replacement pad outlines. Optional reliefs are placed here, away from the motor bearing and screws.
help: Length of the root-facing neck on the twelve replacement pad outlines. Optional reliefs are placed here, away from the motor bearing and screws.

label: Additional pad cutouts
tip: Optional neck relief on the twelve replacement motor-pad outlines. Neck length and the cutout dimensions set the available material. Holes and slots rotate with the pad and are checked against mounting hardware and outline material.
help: Optional neck relief on the twelve replacement motor-pad outlines. Neck length and the cutout dimensions set the available material. Holes and slots rotate with the pad and are checked against mounting hardware and outline material.

label: Pad cutout width / diameter
tip: Slot width or circular relief diameter on the new pad outlines. Paired openings keep at least Minimum web between them. The native builder checks remaining edge and screw support.
help: Slot width or circular relief diameter on the new pad outlines. Paired openings keep at least Minimum web between them. The native builder checks remaining edge and screw support.

label: Pad cutout slot length
tip: Overall slot length along the motor-pad axis. Used by Neck slot and Twin neck slots; ignored for twin circular holes. Must be at least the width.
help: Overall slot length along the motor-pad axis. Used by Neck slot and Twin neck slots; ignored for twin circular holes. Must be at least the width.

label: Motor mounting pattern
help: Four-hole bolt circle uses 90-degree intervals; three-hole bolt circle uses 120-degree intervals. Enter the measured diameter through the fixing-hole centres.

label: Motor bolt circle diameter
help: Diameter through the centres of the motor fixing holes. Measure your actual motor; this is not square side length.

label: Motor hole rotation
tip: Rotates the 3-hole or 4-hole bolt-circle pattern about each motor centre, relative to that arm and pad. Zero puts one hole toward the outward arm tip. Positive angles turn counterclockwise when viewed from above. The pad outline and centre bore do not rotate.
help: Clocking angle for either bolt-circle pattern, relative to local pad axes. At zero, one hole points toward the tip; positive turns counterclockwise in top view. Only fixing holes rotate; the pad and centre bore stay fixed.

label: MotorHoleDiameter
help: Diameter of the four motor fixing holes. Match the measured motor threads and required bolt clearance.

label: Motor centre bore
help: Central opening below the motor shaft or bearing housing. Keep enough material between this bore, the fixing holes and the pad edge.

label: Motor reference bell diameter
help: Outside diameter of the approximate motor body/bell reference. Stator numbers such as 1404 do not specify the outside bell diameter. Does not resize mounting holes or the pad.

label: Motor reference body height
tip: Motor bell body height. The detailed M5 shaft and self-locking nut extend above the bell.
help: Motor bell body height. The detailed M5 shaft and self-locking nut extend above the bell.

label: Prop plane above motor mounting face
tip: Height for simple prop discs only. Detailed props sit directly on the motor bell and ignore this dimension.
help: Height for simple prop discs only. Detailed props sit directly on the motor bell and ignore this dimension.

label: Arm nut retention
tip: Retention for non-shared arm bolts only. Shared arm/standoff bolts keep their threaded standoffs.
help: Retention for non-shared arm bolts only. Shared arm/standoff bolts keep their threaded standoffs.

label: FC stack press nuts
tip: Use M3 press nuts in the stack carrier. Places the stack directly on the exposed flange, overriding manual spacer height; upper conventional nuts follow the stack.
help: Use M3 press nuts in the stack carrier. Places the stack directly on the exposed flange, overriding manual spacer height; upper conventional nuts follow the stack.

label: Hex nut recess depth
tip: Partial hexagonal pocket depth into the receiving face. At least 1 mm of plate thickness must remain.
help: Partial hexagonal pocket depth into the receiving face. At least 1 mm of plate thickness must remain.

label: Nut pocket fit allowance
tip: Added to hex nut across-flats width and to circular flange-pocket diameter. Not a radial allowance.
help: Added to hex nut across-flats width and to circular flange-pocket diameter. Not a radial allowance.

label: M3 press-nut mounting bore
tip: Through-hole diameter in the receiving plate. Default KF2/KFS2 M3 mounting hole: 4.22 mm (+0.08 mm). Other FPV inserts may need 4.55 mm; use the purchased insert drawing.
help: Through-hole diameter in the receiving plate. Default KF2/KFS2 M3 mounting hole: 4.22 mm (+0.08 mm). Other FPV inserts may need 4.55 mm; use the purchased insert drawing.

label: Press-nut flange diameter
tip: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 E dimension, used for the reference and optional flange pocket.
help: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 E dimension, used for the reference and optional flange pocket.

label: Press-nut flange height
tip: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 T dimension. The flange remains proud unless recessed.
help: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 T dimension. The flange remains proud unless recessed.

label: Press-nut shank envelope diameter
tip: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 C dimension. A smooth reference envelope for the broaching teeth; interference with the smaller mounting bore is intentional.
help: Default KF2/KFS2 M3 C dimension. A smooth reference envelope for the broaching teeth; interference with the smaller mounting bore is intentional.

label: Press-nut shank depth
tip: Maximum inserted shank length used in the simplified hardware reference; this is not a blind-hole depth.
help: Maximum inserted shank length used in the simplified hardware reference; this is not a blind-hole depth.

label: Press-nut flange recess depth
tip: Optional circular flange counterbore. Zero leaves the flange outside. Remaining plate must meet the insert minimum thickness.
help: Optional circular flange counterbore. Zero leaves the flange outside. Remaining plate must meet the insert minimum thickness.

label: Press-nut minimum plate thickness
tip: Default KF2/KFS2 minimum supporting sheet thickness after flange recess. Change only to match a specific purchased insert.
help: Default KF2/KFS2 minimum supporting sheet thickness after flange recess. Change only to match a specific purchased insert.

label: Number of standoffs
tip: Choose 4, 6, or 8 standoffs in 2, 3, or 4 mirrored left/right pairs. Extra pair positions are adjustable below.
help: Choose 4, 6, or 8 standoffs in 2, 3, or 4 mirrored left/right pairs. Extra pair positions are adjustable below.

label: Standoff outside diameter
help: Outside diameter of the standoff tubes. The mounting surfaces must support their bearing footprints.

label: Standoff through-hole diameter
help: Through-hole diameter in the approximate standoff tube and its plate mounting bores. Match the intended screws and shared arm-root holes.

label: Front pair position
tip: Custom uses the spacing fields. Arm-hole choices snap this pair exactly onto the front arm bolt centres and follow geometry changes. In three plates these standoffs sit on the mid arm tabs.
help: Custom uses the spacing fields. Arm-hole choices snap this pair exactly onto the front arm bolt centres and follow geometry changes. In three plates these standoffs sit on the mid arm tabs.

label: Rear pair position
tip: Custom uses the spacing fields. Arm-hole choices snap this pair exactly onto rear arm bolt centres. Shared holes require matching diameters and supporting material.
help: Custom uses the spacing fields. Arm-hole choices snap this pair exactly onto rear arm bolt centres. Shared holes require matching diameters and supporting material.

label: Outer pairs left–right spacing
help: Left/right spacing of the front and rear custom standoff pairs. Arm-hole position modes instead use the actual mirrored arm bolt coordinates.

label: Outer pairs front–rear spacing
help: Front/rear spacing of the two outer custom pairs, measured between pair centres. Arm-hole modes follow the arm bolts instead.

label: Pair 3 position mode
tip: Choose a custom pair position or snap it to a front/rear arm inner/outer bolt pair. Near misses and incompatible diameters are rejected.
help: Choose a custom pair position or snap it to a front/rear arm inner/outer bolt pair. Near misses and incompatible diameters are rejected.

label: Pair 3 position Y
tip: Extra pair centre along Y: negative is rear, positive is front. Keep it between the outer pairs. Its mounting plate determines its length.
help: Extra pair centre along Y: negative is rear, positive is front. Keep it between the outer pairs. Its mounting plate determines its length.

label: Pair 3 left–right spacing
help: Left/right separation of pair 3 in Custom position mode. Its centre Y is set separately; snapped arm-hole modes override these coordinates.

label: Pair 4 position mode
tip: Choose a custom pair position or snap it to a front/rear arm inner/outer bolt pair. Near misses and incompatible diameters are rejected.
help: Choose a custom pair position or snap it to a front/rear arm inner/outer bolt pair. Near misses and incompatible diameters are rejected.

label: Pair 4 position Y
tip: Extra pair centre along Y: negative is rear, positive is front. Keep it between the outer pairs. Its mounting plate determines its length.
help: Extra pair centre along Y: negative is rear, positive is front. Keep it between the outer pairs. Its mounting plate determines its length.

label: Pair 4 left–right spacing
help: Left/right separation of pair 4 in Custom position mode. It is active only when eight standoffs are selected.

label: Rear standoff height
tip: Actual rear pair length. Other pairs are linked to keep the top level. Pairs on the mid or combined clamp have different bases from pairs on the bottom. Lengths follow the actual support and keep the top level.
help: Actual rear pair length. Other pairs are linked to keep the top level. Pairs on the mid or combined clamp have different bases from pairs on the bottom. Lengths follow the actual support and keep the top level.

label: FC stack mounting pattern
tip: Use 30.5, 25.5, or 20 mm for the square pattern. Hole diameter is separate.
help: Select 20 x 20 mm or 30.5 x 30.5 mm centre-to-centre FC/ESC screw spacing. Both editor and native project offer these two choices. Stack mount height and stack clearance remain independently adjustable. Older nonstandard numeric settings map to the nearest supported pattern with a warning; review before updating the frame.

label: Stack hole diameter
tip: 30.5 mm stacks often use M3; some 20 mm / 25.5 mm stacks use M2. Match your hardware.
help: Electronics mounting-hole diameter. Match the stack screws and required clearance.

label: StackOffsetY
help: Moves the FC/ESC stack and its mounting holes along frame Y. Positive moves it toward the front.

label: Stack spacer height
tip: Spacer above the carrier without FC press nuts. With FC press nuts enabled, the stack starts directly on the exposed flange and this value is ignored.
help: Spacer above the carrier without FC press nuts. With FC press nuts enabled, the stack starts directly on the exposed flange and this value is ignored.

label: FC / ESC stack envelope height
tip: Approximate assembled FC/ESC height above its spacers. Check actual connectors and components; the reference is excluded from manufacturing exports.
help: Height of the FC/ESC electronics envelope above its mounting spacers.

label: Stack screw access diameter
tip: Default 6 mm service openings beneath the FC carrier: in the lower clamp for below-bottom arms, or in the bottom beneath an upper clamp or mid. The carrier keeps normal mounting holes. Matching arm and keystone reliefs preserve screw access.
help: Default 6 mm service openings beneath the FC carrier: in the lower clamp for below-bottom arms, or in the bottom beneath an upper clamp or mid. The carrier keeps normal mounting holes. Matching arm and keystone reliefs preserve screw access.

label: Include equipment estimates
help: Include nominal motors, propellers, FC, ESC, enabled FPV camera/VTX, automatically counted screws and an extra equipment allowance. Bare-frame results stay separate. Reference visibility does not affect masses. The CG marker uses loaded CG when the battery is enabled, equipped CG otherwise; with this option off it shows bare-frame CG.

label: Motor mass (each)
help: Mass of each motor including wires, multiplied by four and located at its actual motor centre (including pad rotation). Default 30.5 g represents a 2207 motor. Change it for smaller or larger motors; changing mounting pitch does not guess a new mass.

label: Propeller mass (each)
help: Mass of each of the four propellers, placed at its motor XY and prop reference height. Default 4 g is a 5-inch planning allowance; enter the actual prop mass.

label: Flight controller mass
help: Mass of the flight controller. Default 10.5 g is a representative 30.5 mm FC value. Its assumed centre is at 75 percent of the stack envelope height above the selected stack support.

label: 4-in-1 ESC mass
help: Mass of one 4-in-1 ESC, default 23.5 g. Its assumed centre is at 25 percent of the stack envelope height. It follows the bottom, clamp or mid stack deck automatically.

label: VTX mass
help: Mass of the VTX, included only in FPV mode. Default 10 g is a nominal allowance, not a digital-unit specification. Enter the mass of your actual analog or digital VTX. Located at the rear VTX envelope centre.

label: Camera mass
help: Camera mass, included only in FPV mode and placed at the tilted camera body centre. Default 10 g is a nominal small-camera allowance. Enter your actual camera mass.

label: Other equipment / wiring allowance
help: Combined allowance for wiring, receiver, antenna, nuts, spacers, straps and other equipment. Default 15 g. Placed at the centre of the FC/ESC stack envelope; this simplified placement limits CG accuracy. Set zero to exclude or replace with a weighed total.

label: Screw mass multiplier
help: Multiplier for automatically counted arm, shared-arm/standoff, top/base, stack, motor and FPV screws. Default 1. Steel mass uses 7.85 g/cm3, 80 percent of the nominal threaded-cylinder volume and a cylindrical head of diameter 1.7 times the screw diameter and height 0.65 times its diameter. Assumed engagement is 2-4 mm depending on location. Lengths follow grip dimensions. Set zero to omit, or scale to your hardware. This is a mass approximation, not a fastener length specification.

label: Enable battery strap openings
tip: Enable the selected top-plate opening style; all dimensions remain saved when disabled.
help: Enable the selected top-plate opening style; all dimensions remain saved when disabled.

label: Top plate strap openings
tip: Choose enclosed slots or open left/right outline cutouts while retaining the saved dimensions and positions. Side guards bridge the outline cutouts along the outside plate edge, leaving the strap passages clear. Use the enable switch to omit openings.
help: Choose enclosed slots or open left/right outline cutouts while retaining the saved dimensions and positions. Side guards bridge the outline cutouts along the outside plate edge, leaving the strap passages clear. Use the enable switch to omit openings.

label: Number of top-plate straps
tip: Choose one left/right opening pair or two pairs. Two-strap spacing remains saved when using one strap.
help: Choose one left/right opening pair or two pairs. Two-strap spacing remains saved when using one strap.

label: Single strap fore/aft position
tip: Single-strap centre in frame Y: zero is centred, positive is forward, negative is rearward. Used for slots and outline cutouts.
help: Single-strap centre in frame Y: zero is centred, positive is forward, negative is rearward. Used for slots and outline cutouts.

label: StrapSlotWidth
help: Width of each enclosed slot. Used only in Slots mode.

label: StrapSlotLength
help: Fore/aft length of each slot or outline cutout. In Slots mode this must exceed slot width.

label: Slot centre distance from centre
help: Distance from frame centre to the front/rear slot rows. The four slots form two mirrored left/right pairs.

label: Slot inset from top plate edge
help: Inward distance from the top plate side edge to each slot centre. Leave material around the opening and nearby fasteners.

label: Outline cutout depth
tip: Depth inward from the local top-plate side edge. Outline cutouts use the existing strap length and fore/aft positions. Inner corners are rounded; slot width and inset remain saved for Slots mode.
help: Depth inward from the local top-plate side edge. Outline cutouts use the existing strap length and fore/aft positions. Inner corners are rounded; slot width and inset remain saved for Slots mode.

label: Battery mounting face
tip: Top plate places the pad and battery above the top carbon face. Bottom plate places them below the bottom carbon face, keeping the pad between plate and pack.
help: Top plate places the pad and battery above the top carbon face. Bottom plate places them below the bottom carbon face, keeping the pad between plate and pack.

label: Battery / pad X offset
tip: Shared left/right placement of the battery and pad in frame coordinates; positive X is right. The frame carbon remains fixed.
help: Shared left/right placement of the battery and pad in frame coordinates; positive X is right. The frame carbon remains fixed.

label: Battery / pad Y offset
tip: Shared front/rear placement of the battery and pad in frame coordinates; positive Y is forward.
help: Shared front/rear placement of the battery and pad in frame coordinates; positive Y is forward.

label: Battery / pad rotation
tip: Rotate the battery footprint and pad together around their shared centre in the frame XY plane. Zero places the longer local dimension along frame Y; positive turns counterclockwise in top view.
help: Rotate the battery footprint and pad together around their shared centre in the frame XY plane. Zero places the longer local dimension along frame Y; positive turns counterclockwise in top view.

label: Show LiPo reference
tip: Display the editable nominal 1300 mAh 6S battery envelope when Show references is on. It is excluded from manufactured parts and bare-frame mass; its mass is used only in the separately labelled frame-plus-battery estimate.
help: Display the editable nominal 1300 mAh 6S battery envelope when Show references is on. It is excluded from manufactured parts and bare-frame mass; its mass is used only in the separately labelled frame-plus-battery estimate.

label: Battery width
tip: Battery envelope width in its local X direction. Default 38 mm; capacity alone does not define pack dimensions.
help: Battery envelope width in its local X direction. Default 38 mm; capacity alone does not define pack dimensions.

label: Battery length
tip: Battery envelope length along local Y before rotation. Default 75 mm.
help: Battery envelope length along local Y before rotation. Default 75 mm.

label: Battery height
tip: Battery envelope height. Default 38 mm. The pack rests on the optional pad or directly on the chosen plate.
help: Battery envelope height. Default 38 mm. The pack rests on the optional pad or directly on the chosen plate.

label: Battery reference mass
tip: Mass used only for the frame-plus-reference-battery estimate. Default 208 g. Weigh your actual pack; this is not a complete aircraft weight.
help: Entered reference pack mass, default 208 g. Added to both the bare frame plus battery and equipped plus battery estimates. Weigh the actual pack.

label: Create LiPo pad
tip: Create one separate pad solid, not carbon. It is included in the native assembly and assembled STEP, and exported separately as flat STL/STEP and an ungrooved DXF/SVG outline.
help: Create one separate pad solid, not carbon. It is included in the native assembly and assembled STEP, and exported separately as flat STL/STEP and an ungrooved DXF/SVG outline. Every pad automatically leaves at least 6 mm radial space from each standoff-hole centre. This also applies to independent pad shapes; disconnected results are rejected.

label: Pad outline
tip: Rounded rectangle uses the corner radius; Rectangle has square corners; Capsule has semicircular ends along its longer dimension.
help: Choose Rounded rectangle, Rectangle, Capsule, Ellipse, Chamfered rectangle, Tapered or Hourglass for an independently sized pad. Mounting plate outline follows the finished carrier sides and openings. Adjust Plate outline width scale for width and independent Pad front reach / Pad rear reach from the stack centre for length. Shortened ends are straight. Zero reach retains that full carrier end. Every pad leaves a 6 mm clear radius around standoff-hole centres.

label: Pad width
tip: Width of the pad before clipping to the carrier. Independent from the battery envelope width.
help: Width of an independent pad before carrier clipping. Disabled for Mounting plate outline: set width with the outline scale. Grip coverage always uses the finished pad footprint; this value does not crop the grip region.

label: Pad length
tip: Length of the pad before clipping to the carrier. Independent from battery length; a smaller pad can sit under a larger battery.
help: Length of an independent pad before carrier clipping. Disabled for Mounting plate outline: set its length with independent front/rear reaches. Grip coverage always uses the finished pad footprint.

label: Pad thickness
tip: Overall pad thickness. Grooves cut into the battery-facing surface and must leave a continuous backing. This height also lifts or lowers the battery reference away from the carbon face.
help: Overall pad thickness. Grooves cut into the battery-facing surface and must leave a continuous backing. This height also lifts or lowers the battery reference away from the carbon face.

label: Pad corner radius
tip: Corner radius for Rounded rectangle. Zero makes square corners; positive values must be smaller than half the shorter pad dimension. Use Capsule for fully rounded ends.
help: Corner radius for Rounded rectangle. Zero makes square corners; positive values must be smaller than half the shorter pad dimension. Use Capsule for fully rounded ends.

label: Follow mounting plate
tip: Clip the pad to the finished mounting plate, including its holes, strap slots and applied cutouts. Disabling this keeps the independent pad outline. CAD rejects empty or disconnected pads.
help: Clip an independently sized pad to the finished carrier footprint. Mounting plate outline always follows the carrier. All pad shapes retain a 6 mm clear radius around standoff-hole centres; empty or disconnected pads are rejected.

label: Plate outline width scale
help: Width percentage of the carrier outline, from 1 to 100 percent. 100 keeps full width. Narrowing scales only frame X about the carrier centre and clips back to the carrier. The front/rear profile is not scaled; use separate reaches from the stack to cut straight ends. Actual openings and 6 mm standoff clearances remain at their real positions.

label: Pad front reach from stack (0 = full)
help: Independent distance in millimetres from the FC stack centre (Stack Offset Y) toward frame +Y. Zero retains the full carrier at this end. A shorter positive distance clips the pad at a straight transverse edge, without rescaling the plate profile along its length. The opposite end is unchanged. Width still follows the carrier outline. Used only with Mounting plate outline.

label: Pad rear reach from stack (0 = full)
help: Independent distance in millimetres from the FC stack centre (Stack Offset Y) toward frame -Y. Zero retains the full carrier at this end. A shorter positive distance clips the pad at a straight transverse edge, without rescaling the plate profile along its length. The opposite end is unchanged. Width still follows the carrier outline. Used only with Mounting plate outline.

label: Grip surface
tip: Solid has a plain contact surface. Transverse grooves run across the local pad width; Cross grooves add perpendicular channels. These are shallow grip features, not through cuts.
help: Choose one of 25 grip patterns shown together in the catalogue. Ten additions provide brick joints, herringbone, plus/X grids, square/diamond islands, triangular lattice, ladder grooves, interrupted ribs and fish scales. Each fills the finished pad and is clipped to its outline and clearances. Width, depth and pitch remain editable.

label: Groove width
tip: Width of each shallow grip channel, measured across the channel.
help: Width of each shallow grip channel, measured across the channel.

label: Groove depth
tip: Depth into the battery-facing surface. Must be smaller than pad thickness so the backing stays continuous.
help: Depth into the battery-facing surface. Must be smaller than pad thickness so the backing stays continuous.

label: Groove spacing
tip: Centre-to-centre spacing of the grip channels. It must exceed groove width; increase it if the groove count exceeds the limit.
help: Spacing between repeated grip features. Must exceed groove width. Pattern count is based on the finished pad, with a maximum of 512 channel segments; increase spacing if a pattern is too dense. Ring spacing is the inset between successive rectangular rings.

label: Pad material density
tip: Density used to convert exact pad volume into its mass estimate. Default 1.2 g/cm3 is a nominal solid TPU value. Enter the actual material/effective printed density; infill and adhesive are not modelled.
help: Density used to convert exact pad volume into its mass estimate. Default 1.2 g/cm3 is a nominal solid TPU value. Enter the actual material/effective printed density; infill and adhesive are not modelled.

label: Video system
tip: Analog and digital cameras can share widths. Select the actual width, body dimensions and screw pattern below; this label does not force one camera model.
help: Analog and digital cameras can share widths. Select the actual width, body dimensions and screw pattern below; this label does not force one camera model.

label: Camera body width
tip: Actual camera width between side faces. Common-size shortcuts set body height, centre the camera and choose taller stock standoffs if necessary.
help: Actual camera width between side faces. Common-size shortcuts set body height, centre the camera and choose taller stock standoffs if necessary.

label: Camera body height
help: Measured camera body height, excluding the lens. Used to check the tilted body envelope and automatic vertical placement.

label: Camera body depth (without lens)
tip: Reference body depth excluding the approximate 6 mm front lens. Measure your camera for clearance checks.
help: Reference body depth excluding the approximate 6 mm front lens. Measure your camera for clearance checks.

label: Extra width clearance (total)
help: Total extra width added across the camera cage, shared between the two sides. It is separate from the camera body width and plate thickness.

label: Camera side screw hole diameter
help: Through-hole or slot width for the camera side screws. Match the camera threads and intended clearance.

label: Vertical screw spacing (0 = pivot)
tip: Vertical centre-to-centre spacing on one camera side, measured with the camera level. Use 6.5 mm for that measured pattern, a custom pitch, or zero for a single pivot screw. Camera body width is independent.
help: Vertical centre-to-centre spacing on one camera side, measured with the camera level. Use 6.5 mm for that measured pattern, a custom pitch, or zero for a single pivot screw. Camera body width is independent.

label: Camera tilt mount
tip: Variable uses a single-screw friction pivot, or a vertical screw pair in upper/lower arc slots. Fixed uses two vertically spaced round holes at the chosen uptilt.
help: Variable uses a single-screw friction pivot, or a vertical screw pair in upper/lower arc slots. Fixed uses two vertically spaced round holes at the chosen uptilt.

label: Variable tilt mechanism
tip: Vertically stacked side screws use centred upper/lower arc slots. The alternative fixes the upper screw and moves the lower screw along an exact arc. Enter the measured vertical pitch.
help: Vertically stacked side screws use centred upper/lower arc slots. The alternative fixes the upper screw and moves the lower screw along an exact arc. Enter the measured vertical pitch.

label: Camera uptilt
tip: Displayed camera angle. In Variable mode it must be inside the adjustment range; changing the preview angle does not change the bracket or arc slots.
help: Displayed camera angle. In Variable mode it must be inside the adjustment range; changing the preview angle does not change the bracket or arc slots.

label: Minimum adjustable tilt
tip: Lowest intended adjustable angle. Clearance is checked across the configured range. Single-screw pivots rely on friction and have no mechanical end stops.
help: Lowest intended adjustable angle. Clearance is checked across the configured range. Single-screw pivots rely on friction and have no mechanical end stops.

label: Maximum adjustable tilt
tip: Highest intended adjustable angle. Two-screw mounts have arc-slot end stops. Fit camera height after changing the range.
help: Highest intended adjustable angle. Two-screw mounts have arc-slot end stops. Fit camera height after changing the range.

label: Camera fore/aft placement
tip: Centre the camera on the actual side plates at its configured height, or choose a custom camera centre Y. Height can be centred or set independently.
help: Centre the camera on the actual side plates at its configured height, or choose a custom camera centre Y. Height can be centred or set independently.

label: Custom camera centre Y
tip: Custom nominal body centre Y (+Y front). With an upper pivot this is the centre at the middle of the variable range. Automatic centres it on the actual side plates.
help: Custom nominal body centre Y (+Y front). With an upper pivot this is the centre at the middle of the variable range. Automatic centres it on the actual side plates.

label: Camera forward / backward offset
tip: Additional camera translation in frame Y: positive moves toward the front, negative toward the rear. Added to Automatic centre or Custom position. Moves the camera, fixing holes/slots and flexible interfaces together; captured tabs and tilt settings remain fixed. Automatic travel support can grow the middle side-wall bearing area; disable it to retain a fixed wall outline. Actual component and material clearances still apply.
help: Additional camera translation in frame Y: positive moves toward the front, negative toward the rear. Added to Automatic centre or Custom position. Moves the camera, fixing holes/slots and flexible interfaces together; captured tabs and tilt settings remain fixed. help: Create one front opening or a front/rear pair on each side guard.

label: Follow plate strap positions
tip: Use +Strap fore/aft offset for one strap and both +/- offsets for two. Positions follow the existing top-plate slots even when those slots are disabled.
help: Use +Strap fore/aft offset for one strap and both +/- offsets for two. Positions follow the existing top-plate slots even when those slots are disabled.

label: Front strap offset
tip: Custom opening centre relative to the FC stack along frame Y. Positive is forward.
help: Custom opening centre relative to the FC stack along frame Y. Positive is forward.

label: Rear strap offset
tip: Independent second opening centre relative to the stack. Used for two straps; negative is rearward.
help: Independent second opening centre relative to the stack. Used for two straps; negative is rearward.

label: Strap opening width
tip: Clear fore/aft opening span in mm. Allow room for the actual strap width and assembly movement.
help: Clear fore/aft opening span in mm. Allow room for the actual strap width and assembly movement.

label: Strap opening depth
tip: Clear depth inward from the chosen guard edge. The cut opens through that edge and retains material at the opposite edge.
help: Clear depth inward from the chosen guard edge. The cut opens through that edge and retains material at the opposite edge.

label: Strap opening edge
tip: Top edge lets straps pass beneath/around the top plate. Bottom edge opens the lower carrier skirt (mid plate in three-plate mode, bottom plate in two-plate mode).
help: Top edge lets straps pass beneath/around the top plate. Bottom edge opens the lower carrier skirt (mid plate in three-plate mode, bottom plate in two-plate mode).

label: Vent boundary offset
tip: Shift the section boundary from the rear FC stack mounting-hole row (stack Y minus half its spacing). Positive moves forward; negative moves rearward. Limited to the guard ends.
help: Shift the section boundary from the rear FC stack mounting-hole row (stack Y minus half its spacing). Positive moves forward; negative moves rearward. Limited to the guard ends.

label: VTX section vents
tip: Enable vents in the rear section. Requires Vented style.
help: Enable vents in the rear section. Requires Vented style.

label: VTX vent shape
tip: VTX section only. Opening profile used by Vented side guards. Individual repeated shapes use vent width and web; horizontal slots span each clear post bay.
help: VTX section only. Opening profile used by Vented side guards. Individual repeated shapes use vent width and web; horizontal slots span each clear post bay.

label: VTX vent width
tip: VTX section only. Fore/aft size of individual repeated vent shapes; horizontal slots use the clear bay length.
help: VTX section only. Fore/aft size of individual repeated vent shapes; horizontal slots use the clear bay length.

label: VTX vent height
tip: VTX section only. Airflow opening height; limited to retain top and bottom material.
help: VTX section only. Airflow opening height; limited to retain top and bottom material.

label: VTX vent rows
tip: VTX section only. Whole-number count of airflow rows (1 to 6); actual openings fit the available panel height.
help: VTX section only. Whole-number count of airflow rows (1 to 6); actual openings fit the available panel height.

label: VTX vent web
tip: VTX section only. Minimum spacing between repeated openings and their bearing regions.
help: VTX section only. Minimum spacing between repeated openings and their bearing regions.

label: VTX vent rear inset
tip: Extra solid material at the rear edge of the VTX vent region.
help: Extra solid material at the rear edge of the VTX vent region.

label: VTX vent front inset
tip: Extra solid material at the front edge of the VTX vent region.
help: Extra solid material at the front edge of the VTX vent region.

label: VTX vent vertical offset
tip: Move VTX rows up (positive) or down (negative), limited to retain top and bottom webs.
help: Move VTX rows up (positive) or down (negative), limited to retain top and bottom webs.

label: FC section vents
tip: Enable vents in the forward section. Disable for VTX-only ventilation.
help: Enable vents in the forward section. Disable for VTX-only ventilation.

label: FC vent shape
tip: Opening shape used only in the FC section.
help: Opening shape used only in the FC section.

label: FC vent width
tip: Fore/aft width of repeated openings. Horizontal slots span each clear FC section/post bay.
help: Fore/aft width of repeated openings. Horizontal slots span each clear FC section/post bay.

label: FC vent height
tip: Requested opening height, reduced to fit the local available wall.
help: Requested opening height, reduced to fit the local available wall.

label: FC vent rows
tip: One to six whole-number rows. Shallow upper strips can use fewer rows.
help: One to six whole-number rows. Shallow upper strips can use fewer rows.

label: FC vent web
tip: Minimum material between openings, posts and section edges; never less than guard thickness.
help: Minimum material between openings, posts and section edges; never less than guard thickness.

label: FC vent rear inset
tip: Extra solid material at the rear edge of the FC vent region.
help: Extra solid material at the rear edge of the FC vent region.

label: FC vent front inset
tip: Extra solid material at the front edge of the FC vent region.
help: Extra solid material at the front edge of the FC vent region.

label: FC vent vertical offset
tip: Move FC rows up (positive) or down (negative), limited to retain top and bottom webs.
help: Move FC rows up (positive) or down (negative), limited to retain top and bottom webs.
